title: 第十一章 超青藏高原71第十一章 超青藏高原 70
content_zh:
六、太阳花与小矮人中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅八个人终于找到光粉的来源地。
不过中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟几个人知道真相，真相是：“这个森林有神奇的小人族一直守护。而光粉的真正面目却是罕有的太阳花的花粉！为了获得更多的花粉去拯救天神木，翔天等人全力协助小人族，希望让太阳花顺利绽放。然而魔王的手下忍者却早一步潜入森林，更在水源里做了手脚，后来美雅感到有空灵族监视。元气勇者三人召唤元气金刚，用震地龙解决水源问题，获得太阳花粉。剩下的元气金刚战胜敌人了，去往天神木。”中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界智之勇者小男孩唐琼凯、中华低阶科技白元勇者世界大熊猫兽小男孩胡伟、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界力之勇者小男孩亚树、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界智之勇小女孩田奈奈、中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅八个人一起来到小矮人们所在的地方。
太阳花就生长在这片空地上，茎干纤细，叶片呈椭圆形，顶端的花苞尚未完全绽放，苞片缝隙间透出淡金色的微光。
小矮人们正围在太阳花周围忙碌着，看到八个人到来，纷纷抬起头。就在这时，中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界引导者猫人族小女孩美雅的耳朵忽然竖起，猫尾绷直。
“空气不对劲。空灵族的气息——从水源那边飘过来的。”空灵族忍者的身影从树林阴影中浮现。
他驾驶着一台中型机甲，关节处加了消音装置，移动时几乎没有声音。
机甲的双臂末端装着两把短柄忍刀，刀身漆黑，刃口泛着暗紫色光泽。
与此同时，树林另一侧传来不协调的金属摩擦声——黑暗伪人星忍者从阴影中滑出，眼白纯黑，驾驶着黑色轻型机甲，眼部是横向的暗红色光带。
机甲手臂末端装着针管状武器，针管里装着暗紫色毒液。两个敌人同时污染水源。
黑暗伪人星忍者的污染源带有寄生作用。那不是普通的毒。黑暗伪人夺舍人类的躯体——一旦有人类喝过被这种污染源煮开的开水，夺舍便已经完成。
水源下游正是小矮人们取水的地方，黑暗伪人星忍者的目标不单是污染水源，而是夺舍饮用此水的小矮人族。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖抬起右腕，召唤器固定在手腕上，星卡插在卡槽中。
“地震龙！”冰蓝色光柱从地面裂缝中喷薄而出。地震龙以钻机形态从光柱中降临——前端搭载两组并列玫红色锥形钻头，机身以浅桃色为基底，搭配深紫色机械骨架线条。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖站在地震龙的同步空间中，操控地震龙变形——钻机钻入地下，装甲板块重新排列，在地底穿行。
钻头在地下深处探测到黑暗伪人星忍者注入的污染源位置。地震龙从污染源正下方破土而出，变形为机器人形态，冰蓝色装甲在阳光下泛着冷光。
背部装甲展开，从白元守护盾的光芒中凝聚出昊天斧——斧刃宽厚，斧面刻着五角星光印，光明伪人力量所化。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界力之者小女孩杨欣颖在同步空间中双手握斧，地震龙便双手握斧。
昊天斧劈入被毒液渗透的岩石，污染源有寄生作用，黑暗伪人正是借此夺舍人类的躯体。
光明伪人力量与寄生污染源碰撞，夺舍的媒介被斩碎，污染源彻底破坏。
中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧抬起右腕，召唤器固定在手腕上，星卡插在卡槽中。

“猛风！”猛风以汽车样子从光柱中浮现——无人超跑，波普撞色涂装，车尾翼搭载激光炮，车头牌照标注
“长城”。随后变形为机器人形态，赤红光柱现身。中华低阶科技白元勇者世界勇之者小女孩黄雪婧站在猛风的同步空间中，操控猛风变形为赛车形态。
中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天同时抬起右腕，徽章插在卡槽中。
“烈风！”烈风拔地而起，赤红色装甲燃烧如火焰。中华低阶科技霹雳勇士之元气勇者世界勇之者小男孩翔天站在图案空间中，操控烈风变形为跑车形态。

6. Sunflowers and Dwarfs Huang Xuejing, a little girl who is a brave person in the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Yang Xinying, a little girl who is a power in the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Tang Qiongkai, a brave boy in the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Hu Wei, a panda beast boy in the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, Yuan of the Thunderbolt Warrior in China's low-level technology Eight people including Xiangtian, a little boy from the world of Qi Braves, Yashu, a little boy from the Chinese low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors, a young boy named Yashu from the Chinese low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors, a little girl named Tian Nana from the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors, and Meiya, a little girl from the cat-human race who is the guide of the low-level technology Thunderbolt Warriors, finally found the source of the light powder.
However, the little girl Huang Xuejing from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, the little girl Yang Xinying from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World, the little boy Tang Qiongkai from the Chinese low-level technology White Yuan Brave World Wisdom, and the little boy Hu Wei from the giant panda beast in the Chinese low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World know the truth. The truth is: "This forest is protected by a magical little human race. And the light The true identity of the powder is the pollen of the rare sunflower! In order to obtain more pollen to save the Celestial Tree, Xiangtian and others tried their best to help the small people, hoping to make the sunflower bloom smoothly. However, the demon king's ninjas sneaked into the forest earlier and even tampered with the water source. Later, Meiya felt that the Hollows were watching. The three Yuanqi Braves summoned the Yuanqi King Kong to solve the water source problem. , obtain the Sun Pollen. The remaining Vitality King Kong defeated the enemy and went to the Celestial Tree. "Huang Xuejing, a brave girl from the White Yuan Brave World of Chinese Low-level Technology, Yang Xinying, a little girl from the White Yuan Brave World of Chinese Low-level Technology, Tang Qiongkai, a brave boy from the White Yuan Brave World of Chinese Low-level Technology, Hu Wei, a giant panda boy from the Chinese Low-level Technology White Yuan Brave World. Eight people, namely Xiangtian, a little boy from the Thunderbolt Warriors of the Vitality Brave World of Science and Technology, Yashu, a little boy from the Chinese low-level science and technology Thunderbolt Warriors of the Vitality Brave World of Power, Tian Nana, a little girl from the Chinese low-level science and technology Thunderbolt Warriors of the Vitality Brave World, Zhi Zhiyong, and Meiya, a little cat girl from the Chinese low-level science and technology Thunderbolt Warriors, came to the place where the dwarves were.
Sunflowers grow in this clearing, with slender stems and oval leaves. The buds at the top have not yet fully bloomed, and a pale golden light shines through the gaps between the bracts.
The dwarfs were busy around the sunflower, and when they saw the eight people arriving, they all raised their heads. At this moment, the ears of Meiya, a little girl from the cat tribe, suddenly stood up and her cat's tail straightened.
"There's something wrong with the air. The breath of the Ethereal Tribe - it's coming from the water source." The figure of the Ninja of the Ethereal Tribe emerged from the shadows of the woods.
He piloted a medium-sized mecha with silencers added to the joints, making it almost silent when moving.
There are two short-handled ninja swords at the ends of the mecha's arms. The blades are dark and the blades glow with a dark purple sheen.
At the same time, there was an incongruous sound of metal friction from the other side of the woods - the dark pseudo-human planet ninja slipped out of the shadows, with pure black eyes, driving a black light mecha, and the eyes were horizontal dark red light strips.
There is a needle-like weapon at the end of the mecha's arm, and the needle tube contains dark purple venom. Two enemies contaminate water sources at the same time.
The source of pollution of the Dark Pseudoman Ninja has a parasitic effect. That's no ordinary poison. The Dark Pseudo Man seizes human bodies - once a human drinks the boiled water boiled by this source of pollution, the body seizing is completed.
The downstream of the water source is where the dwarves draw water. The goal of the dark pseudo-human planet ninja is not only to pollute the water source, but also to seize the dwarves who drink the water.
The little girl Yang Xinying, the world power of China's low-level technology Baiyuan Brave, raised her right wrist, the summoner was fixed on her wrist, and the star card was insertedin the card slot.
"Earthquake Dragon!" Ice blue light beams erupted from the cracks in the ground. Seismosaurus descends from the beam of light in the form of a drill - the front end is equipped with two parallel sets of rose-red conical drill bits, and the body is made of light peach color with dark purple mechanical skeleton lines.
The little girl Yang Xinying, who is a powerful person in the world of Baiyuan Braves of China's low-level technology, stands in the synchronized space of the seismic dragon, controlling the seismic dragon's transformation - the drill drill drills into the ground, the armor plates are rearranged, and it travels underground.
The drill detects the location of the pollution source injected by the Dark Pseudoman Ninja deep underground. Seismosaurus burst out of the ground directly under the source of pollution, transforming into a robot form, its ice-blue armor glowing coldly in the sun.
The armor on the back unfolded, and the Haotian Ax was condensed from the light of Bai Yuan's guardian shield - the ax blade was broad and thick, and the ax surface was engraved with a five-pointed star light seal, which was transformed by the power of the light puppet.
The little girl Yang Xinying, the world power of the White Yuan Brave World of China's low-level technology, holds an ax with both hands in the synchronized space, and the Earthquake Dragon holds the ax with both hands.
The Haotian ax cuts into the rock that is penetrated by the poison. The pollution source has a parasitic effect, and the dark pseudoman uses this to seize the human body.
The power of the pseudo-man of light collided with the source of parasitic pollution, the medium for seizing the body was chopped into pieces, and the source of pollution was completely destroyed.
Huang Xuejing, a little girl from China's low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, raised her right wrist, with the summoner fixed on her wrist and the star card inserted in the card slot.
"Fierce wind!" Fierce wind emerged from the light beam in the shape of a car - an unmanned supercar, with pop color contrasting paint, a laser cannon on the rear wing, and a license plate on the front of the car.
"The Great Wall". Then it transformed into a robot form, and a red beam of light appeared. Huang Xuejing, a little girl from China's low-level technology Baiyuan Brave World, stood in the synchronized space of strong winds and controlled the strong winds to transform into a racing car form.
The little boy Xiangtian raised his right wrist at the same time and inserted the badge into the card slot.
"Gale wind!" Gale wind rose from the ground, and the red armor burned like flames. The young boy Xiangtian of China's low-level technology Thunderbolt Warrior's World of Vitality and Warrior stands in the pattern space and controls the strong wind to transform into the form of a sports car.
